mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.path, m.component, m.perms, m.icon, m.sort, m.visible, m.status FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.menu_type IN ('M', 'C') ORDER BY m.parent_id ASC, m.sort ASC, m.id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != ''
SELECT menu_id FROM sys_role_menu WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
SELECT id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_type, path, component, perms, icon, sort, visible, status, create_time FROM sys_menu ORDER BY parent_id ASC, sort ASC, id ASC
